summary: The proof is complete. The cell comparison, periodic residue reduction, subtree recurrences, exact convolution encoding, and directed rounding invariants are valid, including the root, leaf, periodic-endpoint, and truncated-index boundary cases. Executing the supplied program reproduces PASS, both stated root enclosures, and the integer margin 1564. These enclosures and the exact final integer comparison prove the claimed strict ratio bound, and the initial domination argument establishes finiteness and strict positivity of both integrals.
